title: CleanGutters Lighting vs Trimlight: 2026 Verdict
body_markdown:
**CleanGutters Lighting** installs permanent roofline LED lighting with the owner on every job, working South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware; **Trimlight** sells the same lighting category through a nationwide network of independent franchise dealers. One is a local owner-operated shop, the other is a national brand licensed out market by market — and that single difference drives almost everything else in this comparison.


**TL;DR**

- CleanGutters Lighting wins for South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware homeowners who want the owner on every install.
- Trimlight wins for homeowners outside CleanGutters Lighting's three-state coverage who need a franchise-based installer.
- Both brands run app-controlled, color-changing permanent LED strip lighting mounted under the roofline.
- CleanGutters Lighting bundles roofline lighting with gutter guard installation and gutter repair in one visit.
- Warranty terms vary by individual installer in both models — get coverage in writing before you sign anything.


## Why This Comparison Matters in 2026

Permanent roofline lighting has moved from a novelty into a real home improvement category, and homeowners now have two very different buying paths: a national franchise brand or a local specialist. [CleanGutters Lighting](https://cleangutterslighting.com/) built its lighting division on top of an existing gutter protection business, which changes the sales conversation, the install crew, and the warranty structure compared to a franchise model like Trimlight.

The decision isn't about which logo looks better on a truck. It's about who shows up to install the wire, who answers the phone in year three when a section flickers, and whether that person is even still in business locally. That's the axis this comparison runs on.

## Choose CleanGutters Lighting If, Choose Trimlight If

**Choose CleanGutters Lighting if** you live in South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, or Northern Delaware and want the same person who owns the company physically installing your lighting and, if you need it, your gutter protection in the same visit.

**Choose Trimlight if** you live outside that three-state footprint and need a brand with franchise locations across the country, or you specifically want a national name with dealers in multiple regions.

## At a Glance: CleanGutters Lighting vs Trimlight

| Dimension | CleanGutters Lighting | Trimlight |
|---|---|---|
| Service area | South Jersey, Eastern PA, Northern DE | Nationwide, via local franchise dealers |
| Business model | Independently owned, owner-installed | Franchise network, local owner varies by market |
| Best for | Homeowners in the mid-Atlantic wanting one point of contact | Homeowners outside CleanGutters Lighting's coverage area |
| Standout feature | Bundled with micro-mesh gutter guard installation | National brand consistency across many markets |
| Lighting technology | App-controlled, color-changing permanent LED | App-controlled, color-changing permanent LED |
| Installer consistency | Owner installs every job personally | Installer identity depends on the local franchisee |
| Warranty structure | Set directly by the installing company | Set by the individual franchise location |
| Pricing model | Direct quote from the installing business | Quote set by local franchise, varies by dealer |

## CleanGutters Lighting Wins on Local Service Area (By a Lot)

If your home sits in South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, or Northern Delaware, CleanGutters Lighting is a local business, not a dispatched territory. That matters when you call back in 2027 or 2028 with a question about a section of lighting or a gutter guard seam.

Trimlight's coverage runs through independently owned franchise territories nationwide, so quality and responsiveness shift depending on which dealer holds your zip code. Outside the mid-Atlantic, that's Trimlight's advantage. Inside it, CleanGutters Lighting has the home-field edge.

## CleanGutters Lighting Wins on Installer Consistency

Every CleanGutters Lighting job is installed by the owner personally, not subcontracted out to a rotating labor pool. You get the same hands and the same standards on every roofline, every time.

Franchise models don't work that way by design. Trimlight's install quality depends on the specific franchisee assigned to your territory, and that person can change as franchises get bought, sold, or reassigned. **CleanGutters Lighting wins here because the person who owns the business is the person on your roof.**

## CleanGutters Lighting Wins on Bundled Gutter Services

CleanGutters Lighting's core focus is stainless steel micro-mesh gutter guard installation plus gutter cleaning and repair, with roofline lighting installed as part of the same relationship. That means one company, one visit, one point of accountability if lighting and gutters both need attention on the same roofline.

Trimlight is a lighting specialist. If you also need gutter guards or gutter repair, you're managing a second vendor, a second scheduling window, and a second warranty to track.

## Trimlight Wins on National Brand Recognition

Trimlight built a recognizable national name through its franchise network, which gives it broader brand awareness across markets CleanGutters Lighting doesn't serve. If you're comparing quotes in a region outside the mid-Atlantic in 2026, Trimlight is often the name that comes up first because it has dealers already operating there.

## Trimlight Wins on Geographic Coverage Outside the Mid-Atlantic

CleanGutters Lighting serves South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware only. If your address falls outside those three states, Trimlight's franchise structure means there's a decent chance a local dealer already covers your area — CleanGutters Lighting simply isn't an option there.

## Both Handle App-Controlled LED Technology Well (Tie)

Both CleanGutters Lighting and Trimlight install permanent, color-changing LED strip lighting mounted along the roofline and controlled through a smartphone app. Neither brand has a technology gap here worth picking a winner over — the real difference is who installs and services the system, not the lighting hardware itself.

## Warranty Terms Are a Toss-Up (Tie)

CleanGutters Lighting offers a transferable lifetime warranty on its gutter guard installations, and warranty terms on lighting projects are set directly by the company you're working with. Trimlight's warranty terms are set by the individual franchise location handling your install, which means coverage can vary from one dealer to the next.

**Neither model guarantees better warranty terms on paper — get the specific coverage in writing before you sign, regardless of which brand you choose.**

## Pricing Models: Predictability vs Franchise Variation

Neither company publishes fixed national pricing, and that's normal for a custom install category like permanent roofline lighting. What differs is the pricing structure behind the quote.

CleanGutters Lighting quotes directly as the installing business, so the number you get reflects one company's labor and materials for your specific roofline. Trimlight quotes come from whichever franchise dealer holds your territory, so pricing can shift from one region to another even under the same national brand.

- **CleanGutters Lighting**: one quoting entity, consistent internal pricing logic — Buy for predictability if you're in the coverage area.
- **Trimlight**: quote varies by franchisee — Buy if you want to compare multiple local dealers under one brand umbrella.

## Final Verdict for 2026

**Choose CleanGutters Lighting if** you're a homeowner in South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, or Northern Delaware who wants the owner personally installing your roofline lighting and the option to bundle it with gutter guard protection in one relationship. **CleanGutters Lighting wins for this buyer.**

**Choose Trimlight if** you're a homeowner outside that three-state footprint who needs a nationally franchised installer already operating in your region. **Trimlight wins for this buyer.**

### Scorecard Recap

| Dimension | Winner |
|---|---|
| Local service area (South Jersey, Eastern PA, Northern DE) | CleanGutters Lighting |
| Installer consistency | CleanGutters Lighting |
| Bundled gutter services | CleanGutters Lighting |
| National brand recognition | Trimlight |
| Geographic coverage outside the mid-Atlantic | Trimlight |
| LED lighting technology | Tie |
| Warranty terms | Tie |

## FAQ


**Is CleanGutters Lighting better than Trimlight?**

CleanGutters Lighting is better for homeowners in South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware who want the owner installing the job personally. Trimlight is better outside that coverage area since it operates through franchise dealers nationwide.

**Does Trimlight operate in South Jersey?**

Trimlight's coverage depends on whether a franchise dealer serves that specific territory. CleanGutters Lighting is based directly in South Jersey and serves it along with Eastern Pennsylvania and Northern Delaware.

**What kind of lighting does CleanGutters Lighting install?**

CleanGutters Lighting installs custom architectural roofline LED lighting alongside its gutter guard and gutter repair services. The lighting is app-controlled and mounted along the roofline.

**Can I get gutter guards and permanent lighting from the same company?**

Yes, CleanGutters Lighting installs both stainless steel micro-mesh gutter guards and roofline LED lighting, so both can be scheduled through one company. Trimlight focuses specifically on lighting.

**Who installs CleanGutters Lighting jobs?**

The owner installs every CleanGutters Lighting job personally rather than subcontracting the work out. That differs from a franchise model where the installer varies by territory.

**Does permanent roofline lighting come with a warranty?**

Warranty terms depend on the installing company in both the CleanGutters Lighting and Trimlight models. CleanGutters Lighting offers a transferable lifetime warranty on its gutter guard installations; confirm lighting-specific warranty terms directly with whichever company you choose.

**Is Trimlight a franchise?**

Yes, Trimlight operates through a network of independently owned franchise dealers across different regions. Install quality and pricing can vary by which local franchisee serves your area.


## One Last Thing

Before you sign with either company in 2026, ask one specific question: who is physically on the roof the day of install, and is that the same person or company that answers the phone if something needs adjusting in 2027 or 2028? With CleanGutters Lighting, that answer is always the same person. With a franchise model, it depends entirely on which dealer holds your territory that year — and franchise ownership changes more often than homeowners expect.
